svg.title: A custom connector: definition, connector, connection, connection reference and the call at run time
svg.desc: Top row, design time, left to right. The repository folder src/connectors/fieldlink-jobs holds two files: apiDefinition.swagger.json, an OpenAPI 2.0 document with host, paths, operations, schemas, x-ms extensions and the security definition; and apiProperties.json with the connection parameters, OAuth settings and policy templates. They are imported into the custom connector FieldLink Jobs, a row of the Dataverse table connector in the solution CedarConnectors, which reads the environment variables cedar_FieldLinkApiHost, cedar_FieldLinkClientId and cedar_FieldLinkClientSecret when it is saved. A connection is created from the connector by signing in: Dana signs in as the FieldLink integration account cedar-dispatch, and the connection stores the tokens; it belongs to one environment and is shared, never exported. The connection reference cedar_FieldLinkJobs in CedarServiceCore points at the connector and is bound to that connection in each environment. Bottom row, run time: the flow Cedar - Send dispatch to FieldLink runs the action Create a job from a dispatch request; the Power Platform connector runtime looks up the connection, adds the Authorization header with the access token, applies policy templates and custom code if any, and sends POST https://sandbox.fieldlink.example/v1/jobs with the Idempotency-Key header; FieldLink answers 201 or 200 with the job, which becomes the action's outputs. The same connector is usable from cloud flows, canvas and code apps, and Copilot Studio agents.
svg.text: Design time: what a custom connector is made of
Run time: one action, one HTTP request
1 finds the connection behind the reference
3 applies policy templates and custom code
4 builds the request from the operation
the response body becomes the action's outputs (described by the 200/201 schema)
Cloud flows and agent flows, canvas apps and code apps, Copilot Studio agents (as a tool). Logic Apps needs its own copy of
the definition. Every consumer reaches FieldLink only through a connection, so the data policy and the connection's account apply.
